title: Early Neolithic Water Wells Reveal the World’s Oldest Wood Architecture
version: Results, well A; figures 4–5 and S1
lineage: Paraphrased research notes, not a source copy.

passages.locator: Results, well A; figures 4–5 and S1
passages.note: Well A at Altscherbitz has a mortise-and-tenon basal frame with projecting tenons secured by wooden wedges; its oak construction timbers derive from 13 trees felled in 5102 BCE, and a pit plank is dated to 5099 BCE.
